operation.title: What to do
operation.description: Merge joins all files into one PDF, in the order listed. Every other operation works on each file separately.

files.title: PDF URLs
files.description: Direct links to the PDF files. For merging, the order here is the page order.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: For extract and delete (required) and rotate (empty = all pages): pages and ranges like "1-3,7", "10-" (10 to the end) or "last". Extract keeps the order you write.

splitEvery.title: Split: pages per file
splitEvery.description: 1 makes one PDF per page, 10 makes files of 10 pages.

splitRanges.title: Split: custom ranges
splitRanges.description: Instead of a fixed size: one output file per comma-separated range, e.g. "1-2, 3-10, 11-". Overrides pages per file.

password.title: PDF password
password.description: For password-protected PDFs (the password that opens them). Used for every file in this run.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
